title: Alert Pivot Chain
description: Filter an alert by IP or user agent, then walk results through chained pivots.

options.markdown: **IPs:** comma-separated, CIDR and `*` ok. **User agents:** separate with `|` (UA strings contain commas), wildcards ok. Leave either as `*` to skip it. Each stage feeds the next; a stage with no results passes a no-match sentinel downstream.

viz_s2.title: Stage 2 — Network activity for Stage 1 IPs ($ds_s2:job.resultCount$)

viz_s3.title: Stage 3 — Auth activity for Stage 2 users ($ds_s3:job.resultCount$)

viz_s4.title: Stage 4 — Endpoint activity for Stage 3 users ($ds_s4:job.resultCount$)

options.query:
index=REPLACE_ME sourcetype=REPLACE_ME [| makeresults | eval src_ip=split(replace($ip_list|s$, "\s+", ""), ",") | mvexpand src_ip | where src_ip!="" | table src_ip] [| makeresults | eval http_user_agent=split($ua_list|s$, "|") | mvexpand http_user_agent | eval http_user_agent=trim(http_user_agent) | where http_user_agent!="" | table http_user_agent]
| REPLACE_WITH_REST_OF_YOUR_ALERT_PIPELINE
| stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(user) as user values(dest) as dest by src_ip http_user_agent
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)

| stats count values(src_ip) as v
| eval handoff=if(count=0 OR isnull(v), "src_ip=\"__NO_UPSTREAM_RESULTS__\"", "src_ip IN (\"" . mvjoin(v, "\",\"") . "\")")
| table handoff

index=REPLACE_ME_STAGE2 $ds_s1_out:result.handoff$
| stats count values(dest_port) as dest_port values(user) as user by src_ip dest

| stats count values(user) as v
| eval handoff=if(count=0 OR isnull(v), "user=\"__NO_UPSTREAM_RESULTS__\"", "user IN (\"" . mvjoin(v, "\",\"") . "\")")
| table handoff

index=REPLACE_ME_STAGE3 $ds_s2_out:result.handoff$
| stats count(eval(action="failure")) as failures count(eval(action="success")) as successes values(src) as src values(dest) as dest by user

| stats count values(user) as v
| eval handoff=if(count=0 OR isnull(v), "user=\"__NO_UPSTREAM_RESULTS__\"", "user IN (\"" . mvjoin(v, "\",\"") . "\")")
| table handoff

index=REPLACE_ME_STAGE4 $ds_s3_out:result.handoff$
| stats count values(process_name) as process_name values(dest) as host latest(_time) as last_seen by user
| convert ctime(last_seen)
